decisions.briefing: Markets turned risk-off today with the NASDAQ down 1.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, and no new candidates cleared the screener. We're holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash in reserve rather than forcing a buy into weakness.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market weakness today pulled tech-heavy indices down more than the broader market, a pattern typical of risk-off sessions where investors rotate out of higher-beta growth names. No candidate-specific news was available in today's screen to point to a single catalyst. The sharper NASDAQ decline relative to the S&P 500 suggests growth and tech sectors bore the brunt of the selling.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市轉為risk-off，納指跌幅（1.4%）明顯超過標普500（0.4%），反映資金從高增長、高beta的科技股撤出，屬典型的避險情緒。今日篩選未有具體新聞可指向單一觸發因素。納指跌幅較大，顯示科技及增長股承受較大沽壓。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets (like growth stocks) and move toward safety, often causing tech-heavy indices like the NASDAQ to fall more than the broader market. The smart move on these days is usually to hold steady rather than chase new positions, since entering during heightened volatility raises the odds of buying right before a further pullback.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「avoid risk」（risk-off）日子是指投資者普遍沽售風險較高的資產（例如增長股），轉而追求避險資產，令納指等科技股指數跌幅往往大於大盤。在這類日子，較穩健的做法通常是持貨觀望，而非追入新倉位，因為在波動加劇時入市，更容易在進一步下跌前「高追」。
